Satellit is seeking an experienced .NET developer with Java know-how to join a multi-disciplinary team delivering digital identity and authentication capabilities for a major energy-sector engagement. The role involves building, validating and documenting reusable authentication/authorization components, contributing to deployment automation, collaborating with IT stakeholders, and participating in agile squad activities. This position follows a hybrid work model with an expectation of being on-site about two days per week and is planned to start in the mid-October to mid-November timeframe. Full-time commitment is required.
Who are you?

Skills & competences:

• Autonomy

• Teamwork

• Presentation skills

• Communication

• Continuous learning

• Technical documentation

• Analytical problem solving

• Resilience

• Versatility and adaptability

• Continuous integration and deployment practices

• Design, implement, unit-test and document libraries, services or components that handle user authentication and authorization.

• Create example applications and code samples to illustrate how to integrate identity and access services into new or existing systems, and communicate these to engineering teams.

• Customize and extend commercial or open-source products (for example access managers, authorization engines, API gateways, reverse proxies and directory services) and produce supporting documentation for those extensions.

• Improve and automate continuous integration and continuous delivery workflows, including configuration and release automation.

• Work closely with IT and application teams to identify integration points, diagnose issues, and resolve problems when connecting to identity Fabric services.

• Install and configure third-party and open-source components by following technical guides and producing any required deployment notes.

• Take part in squad sprint activities, including planning, execution and retrospective work.

• Own assigned backlog items, drive tasks to completion and report progress to the squad.

• Prepare for and actively participate in meetings and workshops, tracking actions and follow-ups.

• Propose technical solutions that align with requirements and constraints, present them to stakeholders and refine based on feedback.

• Continuously acquire new technical knowledge, standards and tooling needed to fulfill assigned work.

• Proven experience with C# and the .NET ecosystem in a production environment.

• Practical knowledge of Java and familiarity with interoperation between Java and .NET components.

• Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and working with JSON and YAML configurations.

• Hands-on skills with front-end technologies such as JavaScript and frameworks like Vue.js or Blazor.

We are looking for a Full Stack Developer to join a long-term project focused on the development, maintenance, and modernization of a large-scale business-critical application ecosystem. The platform handles high volumes of sensitive data, integrates with multiple external systems, and operates in a highly available production environment.
Key responsibilities

• Design, develop, test, and maintain web applications across the full technology stack.

• Develop and integrate REST APIs.

• Maintain and evolve complex legacy applications while ensuring stability and service continuity.

• Contribute to the migration from legacy technologies (PHP 5.6/7.4, CodeIgniter, AngularJS, JQuery) towards a modern stack based on PHP 8.2+, Laravel, and Vue.js.

• Improve application architecture, code quality, security, and maintainability.

• Participate in technical analysis, troubleshooting, code reviews, testing, and documentation.

• Collaborate closely with developers, analysts, UX/UI specialists, and project stakeholders within an Agile environment.

Additional information

• Professional English required.

• Long-term assignment with renewable contracts.

• Up to 3 days of remote work per week.

• Occasional on-site visits to operational environments and end users.

• Opportunity to work on applications with direct business impact and visibility.

• Strong experience with PHP and modern JavaScript.

• Solid knowledge of a modern PHP framework (Laravel preferred, Symfony also welcomed).

• Experience with a modern frontend framework (Vue.js is a plus).

• Comfortable working across both backend and frontend development.

• Strong understanding of SQL, REST APIs, GIT, and software development best practices.

• Proven experience maintaining and modernizing legacy applications in production environments.

• Ability to identify and remediate security issues in existing codebases.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Technical environment:

• Current stack: PHP 5.6/7.4, CodeIgniter, Smarty, AngularJS, JQuery

• Target stack: PHP 8.2+, Laravel 12+, Vue 3, JavaScript

• Database: PostgreSQL

• Version Control: GIT / GitLab

• Containers: Docker / Podman

• Operating Systems: Linux / Red Hat Enterprise Linux

• CI/CD: Modern CI/CD practices and tools

Nice to have:

• Experience with Laravel and/or Vue.js.

• Background in application modernization and legacy migration projects.

• Knowledge of application security best practices.

• Experience working on high-availability or mission-critical systems.

• Exposure to Symfony, React, Angular, or similar technologies.

Do you also love fries and are looking for a new challenge? Our client is a leading player in the production and development of potato-based delicacies. Due to further growth of the Wielsbeke site, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician in 2 shifts. As a preventive maintenance technician, you are passionate about ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our machines and installations. Your goal? Ensure smooth operation and minimise downtime.
 
 
 
• Be an example in adhering to prescribed guidelines and procedures for a (food) safe, environmentally conscious, and orderly working environment. 
 
• As a technician, you recognise potential problems before they cause breakdowns. You report these findings accurately, allowing us to act proactively and minimise unplanned downtime. 
 
• You perform scheduled maintenance tasks, such as inspections, lubrications, adjustments and replacements. 
 
• You work closely with our operational teams and your technical colleagues to optimise the maintenance plan. 
 
• You provide external employees with the necessary support and follow-up to make their contribution effective and efficient. You also supervise technical trainees and new employees to help them grow in their roles. 
 
• You keep accurate records of maintenance work carried out, using the maintenance software (Ultimo). 

 
 
• You have a technical education or equivalent experience 
 
• You have several years of experience as a technician and a passion for technology 
 
• You have knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic and pneumatic systems 
 
• You have a proactive attitude 
 
• You have logical insight and good problem-solving skills, allowing you to work independently 
 
• You are a team player who contributes to smooth communication and joint success 
 
• You speak Dutch or French or English and are willing to understand other language colleagues 
 
• You are willing to work in a 2-shift regime

Context

 

Our client is going through a large-scale IT transformation. They're looking for an experienced Solution Architect who loves both the big picture and the technical detail, and who wants real impact in a technology leadership role.

 

 

What you'll do

• Design solutions that matter. You'll own end-to-end architecture for key IT initiatives, making sure they're robust, secure and fit for purpose.

• Be the bridge. You'll connect Enterprise Architecture with the delivery teams, turning strategy into solutions that actually get built.

• Team up. You'll work hand in hand with business owners, domain architects and engineers to deliver high-quality results.

• Shape the roadmap. You'll define target architectures and roadmaps for a core business domain, using your hands-on experience.

• Build for reuse. You'll create solution patterns and building blocks that other teams can rely on.

• Share what you know. You'll lead communities of practice, exchange lessons learned with fellow architects and help the architecture practice grow.

 

What you bring

• 10+ years in IT, with solid experience as a Solution Architect on large transformation programmes.

• Strong architecture skills: event-driven and service-based architectures, microservices, RESTful APIs.

• Agile and DevOps experience at scale, including CI/CD. SAFe knowledge is a nice bonus.

• A TOGAF certification, or a similar one.

• Tech you've worked with: .NET, Angular, Azure, Kafka, SQL, BPM/low-code platforms, mainframe backends and SaaS packages.

• The ability to zoom in and out: you're as comfortable writing a strategy document as solving an implementation challenge.

• A pragmatic mindset: you go for what works, not what looks perfect on paper.

• Autonomy and sharp analytical skills: you break down complex problems across teams and locations and come up with actionable answers.

• Strong communication skills: you can convince project teams and senior management alike.

• A mentor's spirit: you enjoy helping newer architects grow.

• Fluent English.

 

Nice to have

• Experience in financial services and its regulatory environment.

• Knowledge of capital markets.

• Familiarity with frameworks like Open Agile Architecture.
